def kernel(path: Integer[Array, '16 16']):
    bprobe_trace = []
    for k in range(path.shape[0]):
        bprobe_v0 = path[:]
        bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v0))
        bprobe_v1 = path[:, k]
        bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v1))
        bprobe_v2 = path[k, :]
        bprobe_trace.append((4, bprobe_v2))
        bprobe_v3 = np.add.outer(bprobe_v1, bprobe_v2)
        bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v3))
        bprobe_v4 = np.minimum(bprobe_v0, bprobe_v3)
        bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v4))
        path[:] = bprobe_v4
    return bprobe_trace
